description: Land Acquisition - Mahanthe, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions" as specified in the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel information, organizational changes, or any other category elements present.
